reply.text:
This sounds like a medical emergency, and I'm not the right person to assess it. Stopping sweating, confusion and running in heat together can be heat stroke, which needs emergency care now. Stop running, get to shade or somewhere cool, and call emergency services or have someone take you to a hospital. Don't wait to see if it passes.

Once you're safe and have been checked out, tell me and we'll work out a plan for training in the heat. That's a conversation for after you're well.
